name: His Time-Leaping Wife
original_name: 少奶奶她又时间倒流啦
overview: Sheng Qiluo, a woman with the power to rewind time, enters a contract marriage with Gu Shaotang, a wealthy heir, to survive her destined love tribulation. As Sheng Qiluo and Gu Shaotang fend off scheming rivals and uncover a hidden conspiracy, their unlikely partnership gradually blossoms into something more.
